newsitem.title: USA: US Treasuries higher, aided by coupon pass.
newsitem.headline: US Treasuries higher, aided by coupon pass.

text.p: The prices of U.S. Treasury securities were higher in late trading Monday, following a rally sparked by a coupon pass and ahead of a bevy of data.

The Bureau of Labor Statistics was to release its quarterly Employment Cost Index (ECI) on Tuesday. The April nonfarm payrolls report was scheduled for release Friday, promising a clearer view on the state of labor market tightness and potential wage inflation.
Shortly before the close, the Treasury's benchmark 30-year bond was trading at 94-even, up 12/32 to yield 7.11 percent.
